observed_controls: Module code receives a model-generated risk/benefit score before plugin import when it is first or weakly rated.
Modules above the configured heuristic threshold are moved to quarantine.
Core-class evolution output is parsed with ast.parse and written as a proposal under updates rather than replacing the running core.
The source records module crashes and increases an internal pain score.

hardening_gates.finding: Autonomy is enabled by default and the daemon periodically invokes simulation, selection, modular genesis, and evolution paths.
Generated or discovered Python modules can later be imported and executed in the host process.
The module safety decision depends on nondeterministic model output and inspects only a bounded source prefix.
Service modules are scheduled as background tasks and are not observed to pass the same plugin safety evaluation path.
Imported modules execute top-level Python code before their run entry point is checked.
Self-integrity logging uses an eight-character MD5 prefix rather than the archive SHA-256 provenance scheme.
AST validity is used for evolution proposals but does not establish behavior, permissions, compatibility, or tests.

admission_boundary: Architecture and source hash are admitted.
Raw source is routed to a code repository only after credential removal, deterministic tests, sandboxing, and operator controls.
No module or core code was executed during this review.
